issues.explanation: Task requires employees get 403 on both the Livewire component and the entity.members route, but change.diff contains no routes file change to prove route-level protection.
cancelRemoval flips public confirmingRemoval with no authorize call, violating authorize-every-action rule (impact is low as it only toggles UI state).
Public input memberRole has no #[Validate] attribute and relies only on inline validate in saveRole, unlike inviteEmail/inviteRole which follow the #[Validate] pattern.

conventions.evidence: Uses app/Actions/* with Gate/policy auth, #[Validate]+validate(), #[Locked] entity, audit channel, migration with down(), docs+CHANGELOG updated; deviations: memberRole without #[Validate] (Members.php:288), cancelRemoval without authorize (Members.php:422)

readability.evidence: Clear names (InviteMember, AcceptInvite, openMember/saveRole), small focused methods, PHPDoc on Actions, Blade modals with semantic markup matching sibling Bulma style

requirements.evidence: Migration unique(entity_id,email) with cascade (change.diff:829-843), model normalize/scopePending/scopeForEmail (624-714), InviteMember 7-day+pending/member/race handling (148-236), Members sendInvite/rate-limit/cancel/open/save/confirm (237-459), PendingInvites accept/decline/session/redirect (460-537), mail view+subject+pt_BR strings (558-604,1081-1101), modals/header/select rules (1305-1362); route file absent so route-level 403 unevidenced

scope.evidence: All hunks serve invites/members/email/docs/tests; dashboard.blade simplification restricts members link to managers which is task-related; no unrelated features

security.evidence: authorize update/assignRole/accept/decline/cancel on every sensitive action, scoped findOrFail for inviteId/membershipId, server-side validation, {{ }} escaping, no secrets in public props, rate-limit 10/hour; gap: cancelRemoval has no authorize

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Actions, policies, Eloquent scopes (pending/notPending/forEmail), existing mail theme and x-input/select; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/EntityInviteMailTest, EntityInviteModelTest, EntityInviteSchemaTest, InviteActionsTest (auth/race/expired/replace), PendingInvitesTest (case-insensitive, expired, idempotent, tamper, 404), MembersTest (403, validation, quota, foreign 404, owner/last-manager 403, modal html), InvitesOnPagesTest (hr/title/buttons)

review.summary: Invite-only membership is fully implemented with model/scopes/factory, four Actions with policies, manager-only Members page with modals and rate limiting, PendingInvites with accept/decline, queued markdown mail with pt_BR strings, and comprehensive Pest tests. Approve with nits: route-level 403 is not evidenced in the diff and cancelRemoval/memberRole have minor convention gaps.
